Careers

Homepage > About Us > Careers

D-Fend Solutions values its employees as our greatest asset. Our professionals and subject matter experts, including personnel from elite military intelligence technology units, provide the best possible solutions to our leading customers around the world. We are proud of our impressive presence across different environments and industries, as well as the results we have helped our customers achieve in contending with their counter-drone challenges.

Learn more about us including our Vision, Mission, and Values!

Contribute to the mission of defeating drone threats and shaping a safer future.

D-Fend Solutions is the pioneer and leader in a new category of C-UAS (counter-drone) defense, RF Cyber Takeover, which brings unprecedented levels of control, safety, and continuity while delivering security against rogue drones.

Be an integral part of our talented and determined teams, thriving in our fast-paced, innovative, and collaborative culture.

Elevate your career and play a key role in building a secure and resilient future!
